whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Mehfil - Hotel Vista Palace,

I noticed your dining and hotel establishment has strong 4.5★ reviews in Buddha Colony, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and room inquiries.

Maine aapke restaurant & hotel ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, menu showcase, aur room inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/mehfilvistapalace

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Mehfil - Hotel Vista Palace) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table reservation, menu showcase, and mobile-first speed for customers in Buddha Colony, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
